text: ないしょ　だけど　このコハク　ポケモンの　いでんしが　のこってると　おれは　にらんでるんだ！

structure.jp: このコハク　ポケモンの　いでんしが　のこってると
structure.en: that Pokémon genes are left in this amber

structure.jp: おれは　にらんでるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と here closes off the thought that the speaker has, like 'that'. のこってると　にらんでる = 'I suspect that they remain'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb here says the result is still there. It is shortened to てる in casual speech. のこってる = 'are still left'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two parts like 'but', here just to lead into what comes next. ないしょ　だけど = 'this is a secret, but'.
